name: Valencia
scopeLimits: 180 valid, distinct DGC INSPIRE cadastral parcel references verified in thirteen bounded cells around the unchanged ranked Valencia WUP locator. Actual GML members matched both numberMatched and numberReturned in all cells; a maxFeatures=3 cap rejected a 38-feature reply. This WFS does not implement offset paging; no offset-paging success is claimed. All 180 fresh exact-reference geometry reads matched, explicit provider absence messages matched both the requested REFCAT and UTM zone, and footprint/source-binding checks passed. Independent GEOS audit in EPSG:25830 found no invalid geometries, duplicates, sampled overlaps above 0.01 m² or operation errors. Only three safe sample geometries are retained in the repository. Citywide completeness, legal title, survey accuracy and parcel coverage exactly at the WUP point remain unverified.
pointBasis: UN WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement centroid; this is not a municipal boundary or a parcel-coverage claim.
registryBasis: Ajuntament de València publishes urban cadastral parcels through its official open-data portal. The Spanish DGC also publishes the national INSPIRE cadastral parcel WFS already used by the shared Madrid/Barcelona provider. These sources establish parcel geometry access, not title or complete city coverage.
remainingUncertainty: Citywide completeness, legal title, survey accuracy and point coverage beyond the bounded evidence remain unverified.
nextStep: Inspect the enabled local parcel map and normal parcel selection.
